call_points.text: FY27 revenue growth guided at mid-teens, assuming aluminium prices stay near current levels.
FY27 capex not yet decided; a decision is due in September, with FY28 dependent on FY27 performance.
Stationary engine order book for the first $100 million is finalised, with $100 million revenue targeted by FY29-FY30.
**Alloy wheel** exit run-rate about **3 million** units against **5.5 million** capacity.
Aluminium EBIT margin at 10.3%, flat year on year; recent capex not yet utilised is holding margins back.
Manpower cost inflation is the main worry, with management saying it is very difficult to pass on to customers.

guidance.statement: FY27 revenue growth expected in mid-teens, assuming aluminium prices stay near current levels.
Net debt/EBITDA expected below 2x in the current year and 1.5x later.
Aluminium business targeted at $1 billion revenue in 2-3 years.
Stationary engine business targeted at $100 million revenue by FY29-FY30.
Consolidated capex of about ₹1,500 Cr for FY27, subject to revision
DR Axion approved capex plan of around ₹430 Cr, may spill into next year
Standalone capex averaging more than ₹1,000 Cr to continue
Sunbeam to reach mid-teens EBITDA margin by Q4
Heavy-horsepower stationary engine revenue target of USD 100 million, first full year FY30

operating_notes.text: Alloy wheel exit run-rate about 3 million units annualised against 5.5 million capacity; FY26 revenue about ₹280 Cr.
Powertrain utilisation at 65-70%, or about 60% including the new large-engine business, which is under 0.5% of powertrain revenue.
Sunbeam capacity utilisation around 70%, expected to fall to 45-50% as legacy products are exited.
Powertrain capacity utilisation is around 70%, seen hard to exceed 75% annually due to seasonality; Aluminium is above 80%.
Alloy wheel installed capacity is 5.8 million units, with 4 million expected this year across Bhiwadi and Shoolagiri.
Current depreciation is close to ₹500 Cr, with ₹250-300 Cr of maintenance capex needed to replace machinery.
